headline: Record deliveries, but profits keep missing
chart_note: 52-week range: $182.00 - $488.54. Currently $367.22, still about 25% below its 52-week high.
why_today: Q2 2026 deliveries hit a record 480,126 vehicles, up 25% YoY and beating estimates by 74,000. Revenue hit a record $28.24B, up 26% YoY. But profits missed again on heavy spending, and shares fell 14.5% on the report despite the record top line.
pro_1: Deliveries and revenue both at all-time highs, ending two years of delivery declines
pro_2: Energy storage deployment up 53% sequentially, a fast-growing side of the business
con_1: Trailing PE of 342x prices in years of flawless execution - extremely little margin for error
con_2: Profits keep missing even as revenue grows, and analyst price target implies only about 7% upside
